title: Quality on the platform
sub: Film 4 of 6 of Governance you can use: quality on the platform. Every check names its owner, its dimension and its level; a scorecard and an issue for each owner are written from every run; checks run where data is typed, loaded and built, and monitoring watches for what no rule names.
howto: The film is painted in watercolour, in the university's own rooms. Behind each person, a soft wash of their side: gold for the business side, cyan for the technical side. Status keeps its colours: green for passed, amber for a warning, red for a failure, grey for not run. An owner's name card is gold, a dimension's chip cyan. Files are paper sheets, copied from the example project; the platform's pages are drawn as forms. Four pins along the data's way are the four places to check.
